3.10 Manufacture of hydrogen

Description of the activity: The theme covers the hydrogen economy and the equipment needed to produce clean hydrogen.

Manufacture of electrolysers used for the production of hydrogen through water electrolysis.

Operation of electrolysers to produce hydrogen is covered under a separate activity and is excluded here.

Proton exchange membrane electrolysis is the key technology for low-carbon hydrogen production.

"Low-carbon hydrogen" means hydrogen whose life-cycle emissions are below 3 tCO2e per tonne of hydrogen.

The activity is classified under NACE code C28.29.

A company qualifies only if at least 50 % of revenue from hydrogen activities is reported.
